svg.aria-label: Left: a square wave and its partial Fourier sums with one, three and ten odd harmonics, converging except for overshoot at the jumps. Right: the line spectrum with amplitudes four over pi k at odd harmonics k
svg.text: square wave = sum of odd sine harmonics
partial sums — grey: 1 harmonic · teal: 3 · copper: 10
the ~9 % overshoot at the jumps never vanishes (Gibbs)
